title: Galaxy groups of the 2MASS Redshift Survey (Tully 2015): galaxies with group membership
provider: Tully (2015), from the 2MASS Redshift Survey of Huchra et al. (2012); served by CDS VizieR (J/AJ/149/171)

limit.description: Maximum number of galaxies; the brightest in Ks are taken first

dist_max.description: Farthest distance, h^-1 Mpc (distances follow velocities with H0 = 100 h)

k_max.description: Faintest 2MASS Ks magnitude (the survey limit is 11.75)

all.description: All 43 038 galaxies of the survey, in 25 475 groups

format: CSV; SGX, SGY, SGZ and Dist in h^-1 Mpc; Vcmba in km/s; Mlum and Mvir in 10^12 solar masses
coverage: 43 038 galaxies brighter than Ks = 11.75 over the whole sky except near the Galactic plane
licence: Published catalogue (AJ 149, 171); cite the references; VizieR terms of use
citation: Tully, R. B. (2015). Galaxy Groups: A 2MASS Catalog. AJ 149, 171. Huchra, J. P., et al. (2012). The 2MASS Redshift Survey. ApJS 199, 26.
